title: Bug Whisperer: Unleashing LLMs to Craft Context-Aware Tests Guided by Path Constraints and Bug Clues
datasets: Official ACM full text is closed and not accessible in this audit; therefore the current 2026 paper's exact experimental dataset and cohort have not been independently verified.

A same-title Zenodo package (10.5281/zenodo.17093597, created 2025-09-10) claims an earlier replication package with a 503-row Defects4J focal-method dataset; its relation to the 2026 TOSEM version is unconfirmed and the counts/model descriptions differ. Do not assign that 503-case cohort to the 2026 article without a version link.
